description: Generación de lodos de PTAS is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Subsecretaría del Medio Ambiente. Repositorio de información respecto a generación de lodos de plantas de tratamiento de aguas servidas. Coverage: Chile. The portal files it under the publisher Subsecretaría del Medio Ambiente. It offers 12 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-07-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
